The '''LU-20 Builder''' was a type of small [[Labor droid/Legends|labor droid]] available during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The LU-20 Builder appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a pet. It was a reward for players of the game ''Lord of Ultima'' as part of the cross-promotion between [[Electronic Arts]]'s free-to-play games; players of ''Lord of Ultima'' who created an account in ''The Old Republic'' by [[April 1]], [[2013]] received the pet.
